kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-collection --manager-account testaccount --manager-account-password testpassword --collection document --metadata '{"title":"text","content":"text","response":"int"}' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCollection

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the target region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the administrator account that has the rds_superuser permission.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361789.html operation to create an account
parameters.help_zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账号名称。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361789.html接口创建账号
parameters.name: manager_account

parameters.help_en: The password of the administrator account
parameters.help_zh: 管理账号密码
parameters.name: manager_account_password

parameters.help_en:
The namespace.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html operation to create a namespace, and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html operation to view the namespace list
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401495.html接口创建，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401502.html接口查看列表
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The name of the collection to be created.

The name must comply with the PostgreSQL object naming conventions
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的集合名。

名称需符合PostgreSQL对象名限制
parameters.name: collection

parameters.help_en:
The vector dimensions.

If you specify this value, an index is built, and the length of Rows.Vector in the subsequent https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401493.html operation for uploading vector data must be consistent with this value. If you do not specify this value, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401499.html operation later to build an index
parameters.help_zh:
向量维度。

如果指定此值，会构建索引，且后续上传向量数据接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401493.html的Rows.Vector长度需和此值一致。如果不指定此值，可以后续调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401499.html构建索引
parameters.name: dimension

parameters.help_en: The fields used to retrieve data via full-text index. Separate multiple fields with commas (,). The fields must be keys defined in Metadata
parameters.help_zh: 用于全文检索的字段，多个字段用英文逗号（,）分隔，且字段必须属于Metadata里定义的key
parameters.name: full_text_retrieval_fields

parameters.help_en:
The metadata of the vector data, which is a JSON string in MAP format. The key represents the field name, and the value represents the data type.

Supported data types:
For the list of data types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424383.html.
The money data type is not supported.

<warning>The id, vector, to_tsvector, and source fields are reserved fields and cannot be used.</warning>
parameters.help_zh:
向量数据的元信息，为MAP格式的JSON字符串。其中key代表字段名，value代表数据类型。

支持的数据类型
数据类型列表详见：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424383.html。
其中money类型暂不支持。

<warning>id、vector、to_tsvector、source字段为保留字段，禁止使用。></warning>
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: The tokenizer used to retrieve data via full-text index. Default value: zh_cn
parameters.help_zh: 用于全文检索的分词器，默认为zh_cn
parameters.name: parser

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The distance metric used to build the vector index. Valid values:
l2: Euclidean distance.
ip: Inner product.
cosine: Cosine similarity
parameters.help_zh:
向量构建索引时的方法。取值说明：
l2：欧氏距离。
ip：点积（内积）距离。
cosine：余弦相似度
parameters.name: metrics

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of neighbors in the HNSW algorithm. The operation automatically sets this value based on the vector dimensions. Typically, you do not need to manually set this value.

Valid values:
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 1 to 1000.
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 2 to 100. Default value: 16.

Recommended settings based on vector dimensions:
Less than or equal to 384: 16.
Greater than 384 and less than or equal to 768: 32.
Greater than 768 and less than or equal to 1024: 64.
Greater than 1024: 128
parameters.help_zh:
HNSW算法中的最大邻居数。接口会根据向量维度自动设置此值，一般不需要手动设置。

取值范围：
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 6.0版实例：1～1000。
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例：2～100，默认值16。

建议根据向量维度来设置：
小于等于384：16
大于384小于等于768：32
大于768小于等于1024：64
大于1024：128
parameters.name: hnsw_m

parameters.help_en:
The size of the candidate set when building the index by using the HNSW algorithm. The value must be greater than or equal to 2 × HNSW_M.

Valid values:
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 40 to 4000.
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 4 to 1000. Default value: 64
parameters.help_zh:
HNSW算法构建索引时的候选集大小。取值需要>= 2*HNSW_M。

取值范围：
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 6.0版实例：40～4000。
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例：4～1000，默认值 64
parameters.name: hnsw_ef_construction

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Product Quantization (PQ) algorithm to accelerate the index. Enable this feature when the data volume exceeds 500,000. Valid values:
0: Disable.
1: Enable (default)
parameters.help_zh:
索引是否开启PQ(Product quantization)算法加速，数据量大于50w时建议开启。取值说明：
0：关闭。
1：开启（默认）
parameters.name: pq_enable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use mmap to build the HNSW index. Default value: 0. If the data does not need to be deleted and you have high requirements for the data upload speed, set this parameter to 1.

Valid values:
0: Build the index by using segment-page storage. This is the default value. In this mode, shared_buffers in PostgreSQL can be used for caching, and operations such as deletion and update are supported.
1: Build the index by using mmap. This mode does not support operations such as deletion and update.

<notice>The ExternalStorage parameter is supported only in V6.0. It is not supported in V7.0.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用mmap构建HNSW索引，默认为0。如果数据不需要删除，且对上传数据的速度性能有要求时，建议设置为1。

取值说明：
0：默认采用段页式存储构建索引，这种模式可以使用PostgreSQL中的shared_buffer做缓存，支持删除和更新等操作。
1：该索引会采用mmap构建索引，该模式不支持删除更新等操作。

<notice>仅6.0版本支持参数ExternalStorage。7.0版本暂不支持。></notice>
parameters.name: external_storage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple database instances. This parameter and the DBInstanceId parameter cannot be empty at the same time. If both parameters are specified, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The scalar index fields. Separate multiple fields with commas (,). The fields must be keys defined in Metadata
parameters.help_zh: 标量索引字段，多个字段用英文逗号（,）分隔，且字段必须属于Metadata里定义的key
parameters.name: metadata_indices

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to support sparse vectors. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否支持稀疏向量。默认值：false
parameters.name: support_sparse

fields.help_en:
The vector index algorithm.

Valid values:
hnswflat: HNSW index without quantization compression (default).
novam: Graph index without quantization compression, suitable for high-performance scenarios such as real-time recommendation
fields.help_zh:
向量索引算法

取值说明：
hnswflat：不带量化压缩的 HNSW 索引（默认值）
novam：不带量化压缩的图索引，适用于实时推荐等高性能场景
fields.name: algorithm

fields.help_en:
The size of the candidate set when building the index by using the HNSW algorithm. Valid values: 4 to 1000. Default value: 64.

This value is required only for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances, and the value must be greater than or equal to 2 × HNSW_M
fields.help_zh:
HNSW算法构建索引时的候选集大小。取值范围：4～1000，默认值64。

仅AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例需要传该值，且取值需要>= 2*HNSW_M
fields.name: hnsw_ef_construction

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of neighbors in the HNSW algorithm. The operation automatically sets this value based on the vector dimensions. Typically, you do not need to manually set this value.

Valid values:
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 1 to 1000.
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 2 to 100. Default value: 16.

Recommended settings based on vector dimensions:
Less than or equal to 384: 16.
Greater than 384 and less than or equal to 768: 32.
Greater than 768 and less than or equal to 1024: 64.
Greater than 1024: 128
fields.help_zh:
HNSW算法中的最大邻居数。接口会根据向量维度自动设置此值，一般不需要手动设置。

取值范围：
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 6.0版实例：1～1000。
AnalyticDB PostgreSQL 7.0版实例：2～100，默认值16。

建议根据向量维度来设置：
小于等于384：16
大于384小于等于768：32
大于768小于等于1024：64
大于1024：128
fields.name: hnsw_m

parameters.help_en: The sparse vector index configuration. If this parameter is passed, a sparse vector index is created
parameters.help_zh: 稀疏向量索引配置。如果传入，则创建稀疏向量索引
parameters.name: sparse_vector_index_config

fields.help_en: The number of Novad lists (partitions). Valid values: [2, 1073741824]. Default value: 256
fields.help_zh: Novad 列表数（分区数）。取值范围：[2, 1073741824]，默认值 256
fields.name: nlist

fields.help_en: The number of rabitq compression bits. Valid values: [1, 8]. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: rabitq 压缩比特数。取值范围：[1, 8]，默认值 3
fields.name: rabitq_bits

parameters.help_en: The dense vector index configuration
parameters.help_zh: 稠密向量索引配置
parameters.name: vector_index_config

parameters.help_en:
The vector index algorithm.

Valid values:
hnswflat: HNSW index without quantization compression (default).
novam: Graph index without quantization compression, suitable for high-performance scenarios such as real-time recommendation.
novad: Partitioned index with rabitq quantization, suitable for large-scale, low-cost retrieval scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
向量索引算法

取值说明：
hnswflat：不带量化压缩的 HNSW 索引（默认值）
novam：不带量化压缩的图索引，适用于实时推荐等高性能场景
novad：带 rabitq 量化的分区索引，适用于大规模低成本检索场景
parameters.name: algorithm
